name: week
title: Registry week
subtitle: What needs a person this week, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Applications waiting, unpaid calls, unapproved distributions, stale prices, overdue identity reviews.
sections.sql: select issue, fund, reference, detail, since from attention_view order by issue, since

sections.title: Compliance
sections.note: Each rule cites its source in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, fund, reference, detail, due_on from compliance_view order by due_on nulls first, rule

sections.title: Register
sections.sql: select fund, holder, holder_ref, holder_type, units, pct_of_fund, value, currency, entered_on, address from register_view order by fund, units desc

name: funds
title: Fund review
subtitle: Holders, value, pending work and compliance per fund

sections.title: Funds
sections.sql: select f.name as fund, f.currency, f.unit_price, f.price_on, (select count(*) from holdings_view h where h.fund_id = f.id and h.units > 0) as holders, (select coalesce(sum(value),0) from holdings_view h where h.fund_id = f.id) as value, (select count(*) from compliance_view c where c.fund = f.name) as compliance_items from funds f order by f.name

sections.title: Distributions
sections.sql: select * from distribution_view order by record_date desc

sections.title: Capital calls
sections.sql: select * from calls_view order by due_on desc, holder
